patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I have a headache. WebMD said brain tumor. My sister said it's because I doom-scroll until 3am every night. I need a licensed professional to tell me which one of them is right.
clinical.presentationShort: 39yo F — mild bilateral HA x few days, no red flags, very worried after Googling.
clinical.presentationLong: 39-year-old female, mild bilateral headache for a few days, no red-flag features, very worried after reading online.

diagnosis.esi2roomsNotes: ESI 5: no ED treatment-area resources are expected; brief evaluation, counseling, and discharge are appropriate.
diagnosis.disposition: Discharge → reassurance, sleep hygiene, hydration, no imaging indicated, clear return precautions
diagnosis.why: No thunderclap onset, no focal deficit, no red flags → no scan. The sister is right. Reassurance and a bedtime ARE the treatment.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 39-year-old woman in athleisure, phone in hand
aiImageGeneration.pose: sitting relaxed, holding her phone up mid-scroll
aiImageGeneration.expression: anxious but healthy-looking, rubbing one temple
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a Black 39-year-old woman in athleisure with a phone in hand, on the same blue clinic chair. Pose: sitting relaxed, holding her phone up mid-scroll, rubbing one temple. Expression: anxious but clearly healthy-looking — NOT in pain. Clearly visible: well-appearing with good color, one hand at her temple. Overall completely well. No text, no logos.
